changes: 新增：EP01-005 西裝酒漬的插入鏡頭，原文只有一句「酒順著翻領往下滴」，拉成獨立鏡頭
新增：EP01-009 最後一秒定格加人物字卡，短劇常用的出場手法；不要的話拿掉這一鏡的 speed 與 post
第 004 鏡：原文是兩人面對面，改成越過沈知意的肩拍；9:16 放不下並排的兩個人
第 007 鏡：原文「許曼回頭」改成頭也不回、手在腰邊往身後一擺；後配口型的說話鏡頭要臉朝鏡頭，手也不抬高擋到嘴
第 008 鏡：原文是彎腰時說「沈董，您到了」，改成站定說完再鞠躬；鞠躬時看不到嘴，對不上口型
第 010 鏡：原文「空杯子停在半空」當卡點，固定鏡頭停在許曼的臉上；空杯從 004 起一直舉在胸前，這一拍才有東西停住

plan.purpose: 許曼當眾羞辱沈知意，經理一句「沈董」讓局勢翻轉。觀眾等到了打臉，也知道沈知意的身分
beats: 許曼攔住沈知意，出言羞辱
許曼把香檳潑在沈知意身上
經理走來，許曼要他趕人
經理對沈知意鞠躬，叫她沈董
plan.blocking: 沈知意剛走進雙開木門，停在門內一步，簽到台在她身側；許曼從宴會廳裡迎上來，背對宴會廳，攔在她面前一步遠。周經理從宴會廳深處走來，經過許曼身邊，停在沈知意面前。軸線在沈知意與許曼之間，機位都在簽到台這一側
plan.mood: 表面熱鬧、底下緊繃；潑酒之後全場安靜，打臉的那一刻重拍落下

setups.desc: 簽到台旁，越過沈知意的右肩朝宴會廳內拍：許曼正面，在畫面右、看向畫面左；吊燈與宴會廳在背景，光從上方來

bg.zh: 挑高的宴會廳，水晶吊燈與鋪白色桌布的圓桌，背景虛化
bg.en: the high-ceilinged banquet hall, crystal chandeliers and round tables in white cloth, softly out of focus

light.zh: 水晶吊燈的暖黃光從上方柔和地灑下，宴會廳深處稍暗
light.en: soft warm light from the crystal chandeliers above, the far end of the hall a little darker

detail.zh: 吊燈的水晶串在光下閃著細小的光點，桌上擺著高腳杯與白色餐巾
detail.en: chandelier crystals glinting with tiny points of light, stemware and white napkins set on the tables

setups.desc: 簽到台旁，越過許曼的左肩朝門口拍：沈知意正面，在畫面左、看向畫面右；敞開的木門與較暗的走廊在背景

bg.zh: 敞開的雙開木門，門外是深紅地毯的走廊，背景虛化
bg.en: the open double wooden doors and the deep red carpeted corridor beyond, softly out of focus

light.zh: 吊燈的暖黃光從上方照下，門外的走廊偏暗
light.en: warm chandelier light from above, the corridor beyond the doors darker

detail.zh: 門框是深色的實木，黃銅把手磨得發亮，走廊牆上有一排壁燈
detail.en: dark solid-wood door frames, brass handles polished bright with use, a row of wall sconces along the corridor

shots.source: 「這裡不是你這種人來的地方」
shots.action: 許曼攔在沈知意面前，冷笑著開口

line.text: 這裡不是你這種人來的地方。

tone.en: contemptuously, her voice lifting at the end

shots.sound: 宴會廳裡低低的交談聲，杯子相碰的輕響

pos.zh: 畫面左側前景，只露出肩膀與後腦，虛焦
pos.en: in the left foreground, only a shoulder and the back of the head visible, out of focus

pos.zh: 站在畫面右側中景，下巴微抬
pos.en: standing in the right midground, chin slightly raised

gaze.en: eyeing the woman in the foreground sideways

hands.zh: 右手端著{P01}停在胸前，左手垂在身側
hands.en: right hand holding {P01} at chest height, left hand at her side

face.zh: 一邊嘴角上揚，眼睛沒有笑意，微微瞇起
face.en: one corner of her mouth lifted, eyes cold and slightly narrowed

end.zh: 取景推近到她的臉與肩膀，栗色大波浪長髮的年輕女子下巴抬得更高，冷笑更明顯
end.en: the framing has pushed in to her face and shoulders; the young woman with long chestnut waves has her chin raised higher, the sneer more pronounced

motion.zh: 栗色大波浪長髮的年輕女子把下巴再抬高一點，視線上下打量，手中的杯子輕輕晃了一下
motion.en: the young woman with long chestnut waves lifts her chin a little higher and looks the other woman up and down; the glass in her hand tilts slightly

bg.zh: 挑高的宴會廳，水晶吊燈與鋪白色桌布的圓桌，幾位端著酒杯的賓客散站在桌邊，背景虛化
bg.en: the high-ceilinged banquet hall, crystal chandeliers and round tables in white cloth, a few guests holding glasses standing among the tables, softly out of focus

shots.action: 兩人在門口對峙，背景的賓客轉頭看

pos.zh: 站在畫面左側，剛走進敞開的木門
pos.en: standing on the left of the frame, just inside the open wooden doors

gaze.en: looking levelly at the woman opposite

hands.en: both hands relaxed at her sides

face.zh: 眼神平穩，下顎放鬆，嘴唇閉著
face.en: steady gaze, relaxed jaw, lips closed

pos.zh: 站在畫面右側，攔在她面前一步遠
pos.en: standing on the right of the frame, blocking her way a step away

hands.zh: 右手端著{P01}，左手垂在身側
hands.en: right hand holding {P01}, left hand at her side

face.zh: 一邊嘴角上揚，眼睛微微瞇起
face.en: one corner of her mouth lifted, eyes slightly narrowed

bg.zh: 敞開的雙開木門與挑高的宴會廳入口，背景裡虛化的賓客轉頭看過來
bg.en: the open double wooden doors and the high-ceilinged hall entrance, blurred guests in the background turning to look

frame.zh: 兩人在畫面中段，頭部在上三分之一
frame.en: both women in the middle band of the frame, heads in the upper third

end.zh: 兩人相隔一步對峙，背景的賓客都看向她們
end.en: the two women face each other a step apart, the guests behind them all watching

motion.zh: 栗色大波浪長髮的年輕女子把重心移到前腳，上身往前逼近一點；黑色及肩直髮的高瘦女子站在原地，垂在身側的手指輕輕收了一下；背景的賓客慢慢轉頭看過來
motion.en: the young woman with long chestnut waves shifts her weight onto her front foot and leans in a little; the tall slim woman with straight shoulder-length black hair holds her ground, the fingers at her sides curling slightly; guests in the background slowly turn to look

shots.action: 沈知意不說話，平靜地看著許曼

pos.zh: 畫面右側前景，只露出栗色長髮與裸露的肩膀，虛焦
pos.en: in the right foreground, only chestnut hair and a bare shoulder visible, out of focus

gaze.zh: 平靜地看著前景的女子
gaze.en: looking calmly at the woman in the foreground

face.zh: 眼神不閃躲，嘴唇自然閉合，下顎放鬆
face.en: eyes steady, lips closed, jaw relaxed

motion.zh: 黑色及肩直髮的高瘦女子沒有說話，慢慢眨了一下眼，呼吸平穩
motion.en: the tall slim woman with straight shoulder-length black hair says nothing and blinks slowly, her breathing even

shots.source: 手腕一甩，半杯香檳全潑在她的前襟上
shots.action: 許曼手腕一甩，把香檳潑在沈知意的白西裝上
shots.sound: 香檳潑出的嘩啦聲，四周的交談聲一下子停住

pos.zh: 畫面左側前景，只露出肩膀與後腦，虛焦
pos.en: in the left foreground, only her shoulder and the back of her head visible, out of focus

pos.zh: 站在畫面右側中景，上半身微微前傾
pos.en: standing in the right midground, leaning slightly forward

gaze.en: staring at the chest of the woman in the foreground

hands.zh: 右手握著{P01}，手腕正要往前甩
hands.en: right hand gripping {P01}, wrist about to flick forward

face.en: biting her lower lip, eyes hard

end.zh: 栗色大波浪長髮的年輕女子手中的杯子空了，手腕停在往前甩出去的位置，前景女子的肩頭濕了一片，幾顆酒珠從肩旁飛過
end.en: the glass in the young woman's hand is empty, her wrist stopped at the end of the flick, the shoulder of the woman in the foreground wet, a few drops of champagne flying past it

motion.zh: 栗色大波浪長髮的年輕女子手腕一甩，嘴角跟著往上一扯，杯中的香檳整片潑向黑色及肩直髮的高瘦女子，打在前景女子身前、從肩旁濺開；黑色及肩直髮的高瘦女子的肩膀輕輕一頓，站在原地
motion.en: the young woman with long chestnut waves flicks her wrist, the corner of her mouth jerking up, and throws the champagne at the tall slim woman with straight shoulder-length black hair; it hits the woman in the foreground and splashes past her shoulder; the tall slim woman's shoulders give a small jolt and she stands her ground

shots.risk: 液體潑出去、又要落在人身上，動作快。工具做不好時拆成兩鏡：只拍杯子與手腕一甩，再切到 005 西裝上的濕痕
shots.continuity: 軸線同 001：沈知意在左前景、許曼在右；潑出去的酒落在沈知意的前襟，下一鏡的插入拍到

bg.zh: 挑高的宴會廳，水晶吊燈與鋪白色桌布的圓桌，幾位端著酒杯的賓客散站在桌邊，背景虛化
bg.en: the high-ceilinged banquet hall, crystal chandeliers and round tables in white cloth, a few guests holding glasses standing among the tables, softly out of focus

shots.action: 西裝翻領上的酒往下滴

pos.en: filling the centre of the frame

partial.zh: 白色羊毛西裝外套的翻領，一片顏色變深的濕痕，帶著淡淡的金黃色，酒珠掛在布料邊緣
partial.en: the lapel of the white wool jacket, a darkened wet patch with a faint golden tinge, beads of champagne hanging at its edge

end.zh: 濕痕從翻領往下擴到胸前
end.en: the wet patch has spread from the lapel down over the chest

motion.zh: 香檳沿著翻領的布料一滴一滴往下落，濕痕慢慢擴開
motion.en: champagne drips from the lapel one drop at a time as the wet patch slowly spreads

shots.source: 沈知意低頭看了一眼，又抬起頭
shots.action: 沈知意低頭看了一眼酒漬，再抬起頭
shots.sound: 全場安靜，只剩遠處一聲杯子輕碰

gaze.en: looking down at the wet patch on her chest

face.en: brows unmoved, mouth set in a flat line

end.zh: 黑色及肩直髮的高瘦女子抬起頭，平靜地看向前方
end.en: the tall slim woman with straight shoulder-length black hair has raised her head and looks calmly ahead

motion.zh: 黑色及肩直髮的高瘦女子低頭看了一眼胸前的濕痕，停了一拍，再慢慢抬起眼睛
motion.en: the tall slim woman with straight shoulder-length black hair glances down at the wet patch on her chest, pauses a beat, then slowly lifts her eyes

shots.action: 周經理從廳裡快步走來，許曼頭也不回，手往身後一擺要他趕人；周經理走近時，許曼讓開半步

pos.zh: 畫面左側前景，只露出肩膀與後腦，虛焦
pos.en: in the left foreground, only her shoulder and the back of her head visible, out of focus

pos.zh: 站在畫面中央偏右的中景，臉朝前景的女子
pos.en: standing in the midground just right of centre, facing the woman by the camera

gaze.zh: 斜眼看著鏡頭這一側的女子
gaze.en: looking sidelong at the woman on the camera side

hands.zh: 右手拿著{P01:空}停在胸前，左手在腰邊往身後的宴會廳一擺
hands.en: right hand holding {P01:空} at chest height, left hand sweeping back toward the hall at waist level

face.zh: 下巴揚起，嘴角帶著得意的笑
face.en: chin up, a smug smile at the corner of her mouth

pos.zh: 從畫面右後方的宴會廳深處快步走來，在背景，略虛
pos.en: walking briskly out of the depths of the hall in the right background, slightly soft

face.en: brows slightly drawn, lips pressed together

end.zh: 戴細框眼鏡的灰髮中年男子從栗色大波浪長髮的年輕女子身側走過，停在前景女子面前；栗色大波浪長髮的年輕女子退到他身後右側，空杯還舉在胸前
end.en: the grey-haired middle-aged man in thin-framed glasses has passed the young woman and stopped in front of the woman in the foreground; the young woman now stands behind him to the right, the empty glass still held at her chest

motion.zh: 栗色大波浪長髮的年輕女子頭也不回，下巴揚起，嘴角掛著得意的笑，左手在腰邊往身後的宴會廳一擺；戴細框眼鏡的灰髮中年男子從背景快步走近，栗色大波浪長髮的年輕女子往後讓了半步
motion.en: without turning around, the young woman with long chestnut waves lifts her chin with a smug smile and sweeps her left hand back toward the hall at waist level; the grey-haired middle-aged man in thin-framed glasses walks briskly forward from the background and the young woman steps half a pace back to let him pass

bg.zh: 挑高的宴會廳，水晶吊燈與鋪白色桌布的圓桌，幾位端著酒杯的賓客散站在桌邊，背景虛化
bg.en: the high-ceilinged banquet hall, crystal chandeliers and round tables in white cloth, a few guests holding glasses standing among the tables, softly out of focus

shots.continuity: 許曼的空杯從 004 甩完之後一直舉在胸前，008 在後景也舉著，010 停在半空

shots.source: 在沈知意面前停下，彎腰：「沈董，您到了」

shots.music: 配樂在這一鏡完全抽空

pos.zh: 畫面左側前景，只露出肩膀與後腦，虛焦

motion.en: the grey-haired middle-aged man in thin-framed glasses stands still facing the woman in the foreground, eyes lowered, head steady, then after a beat bows from the waist

bg.zh: 挑高的宴會廳，水晶吊燈與鋪白色桌布的圓桌，幾位端著酒杯的賓客散站在桌邊，背景虛化
bg.en: the high-ceilinged banquet hall, crystal chandeliers and round tables in white cloth, a few guests holding glasses standing among the tables, softly out of focus

shots.action: 沈知意抬起下巴，看向許曼；最後一秒定格出字卡
shots.music: 定格的那一刻重拍落下

pos.en: her face in the upper middle of the frame

face.zh: 嘴角微微上揚，沒有笑出來，眼神很穩

shots.post: 最後一秒定格，右側加人物字卡「沈知意｜沈氏集團董事長」，配一聲重音效

shots.source: 許曼手上的空杯子停在半空
shots.action: 許曼的笑垮下來，杯子停在半空

hands.en: right hand holding {P01:空} frozen in mid-air

face.zh: 臉上的笑僵住，嘴唇微張

end.zh: 栗色大波浪長髮的年輕女子的笑已經垮掉，嘴角往下，嘴唇微張，舉著空杯的手停在半空，身後的賓客都看著她

motion.zh: 栗色大波浪長髮的年輕女子臉上的笑一點一點垮下來，舉著杯子的手停在半空，忘了放下
